fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM80,485. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0006047/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: SPM/V with five (5) Credits in: Bahasa Melayu, English, Mathematics, one (1) Science subject (Biology / Physics / Chemistry / General Science / Applied Science), and one (1) other subject; OR O-level with Grade C in: English, Mathematics, one (1) Science subject, and two (2) other subjects; OR Health Sciences Certificate (MQF Level 3) with 2.00 CGPA; OR SKM Level 3 in related fields and SPM with one (1) Credit; OR Community College Certificate (MQF Level 3) in related fields and SPM with one (1) Credit; OR Polytechnic Certificate (MQF Level 3) in related fields with 2.00 CGPA; OR MARA Skills Institute Certificate (MQF Level 3) in related fields with 2.00 CGPA; OR UEC with Grade B in three (3) subjects; OR Other qualifications recognized as equivalent by the Government of Malaysia.
